hypotheses.statement: The plan and report refer to different input or dataset versions.
hypotheses.observed_problem: The reported result is not yet comparable with the plan.
missing_evidence: exact dataset version for the reported run
counterevidence_queries: Find a run manifest proving identical dataset versions.
assumptions: The report describes the run under review.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The exact dataset version is absent.
predicted_observations: The run manifest identifies a version different from the plan.

discriminating_tests.procedure_candidate: Compare plan and run manifest identifiers without changing either source.
discriminating_tests.expected_if_true: At least one material version differs.

hypotheses.statement: The evaluator or system configuration differs from the declared baseline.
hypotheses.observed_problem: The reported result is not yet comparable with the plan.
counterevidence_queries: Find a sealed configuration record matching the baseline.
assumptions: Configuration labels map to material settings.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The changed settings are not enumerated.
predicted_observations: A configuration diff identifies at least one material setting.

discriminating_tests.procedure_candidate: Diff sealed configuration manifests and replay only in a sandbox.
discriminating_tests.expected_if_true: A material configuration difference appears and affects the replay.
discriminating_tests.expected_if_alternative: No material difference appears or the replay is unchanged.

hypotheses.statement: An unobserved factor outside the currently indexed documents explains the mismatch.
hypotheses.observed_problem: The reported result is not yet comparable with the plan.
missing_evidence: run manifest, environment record, and evaluator receipt
counterevidence_queries: Search authorized stores for the missing run identity and environment record.
assumptions: The current source set is incomplete.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The causal locus is unknown because critical records are missing.
predicted_observations: Additional authorized evidence introduces a new causal locus or closes this branch.

discriminating_tests.procedure_candidate: Search only authorized project sources for missing run records.
discriminating_tests.expected_if_true: A new material factor is found.
discriminating_tests.expected_if_alternative: No new factor is found within the bounded search.

alternatives.specification: Compare the declared and observed version identifiers.
alternatives.expected_information_value: Determines whether input identity blocks comparison.

alternatives.specification: Replay the evaluator with sealed candidate configurations in isolation.
alternatives.expected_information_value: Tests whether configuration differences change the result.

alternatives.specification: Prepare a controlled rerun under the approved baseline; do not execute automatically.
alternatives.expected_information_value: Produces comparable evidence if approved and executed by the test owner.
missing_evidence: approved test slot and baseline manifest

decision_analysis.decision: Select the next information-gaining action without changing official criteria.

criteria.name: information gain before irreversible cost
criteria.rationale: Prefer bounded read-only checks before protected physical work.

decision_analysis.uncertainty: The exact run manifest is missing.
decision_analysis.sensitivity: If a matching sealed manifest is found, the controlled rerun may be unnecessary.
